# gurubhat

> A public notebook by Gurudas Bhat, trying to notice the present before it becomes obvious.

This site contains essays on technology, ambition, internet culture, work, status, AI, product, and the strange ways the present enters ordinary life.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://gurubhat.xyz/): Latest essays and working threads.
- [Writing](https://gurubhat.xyz/writing.html): Full archive of published essays.
- [About](https://gurubhat.xyz/about.html): About Gurudas Bhat and the site.
- [Proof of Work](https://gurubhat.xyz/proof-of-work.html): Work, education, and signals behind the writing.
- [Shelf](https://gurubhat.xyz/shelf.html): Books and inputs behind the site.
- [RSS](https://gurubhat.xyz/feed.xml): Feed of published essays.

## Essays

- [Tara and the Absence of Wu Wei](https://gurubhat.xyz/posts/tara-and-the-absence-of-wu-wei.html): On building Tara, forcing OpenCode into the wrong shape, and realizing the missing thing was not a better interface but a reason for the interface to exist.
- [The Social Cost of Not Knowing](https://gurubhat.xyz/posts/the-social-cost-of-not-knowing.html): On ChatGPT, Amma, and the private relief of asking questions without being judged.
- [In a Very Chinese Time of My Life](https://gurubhat.xyz/posts/in-a-very-chinese-time-of-my-life.html): On DeepSeek, dramas, supply chains, and the strange intimacy of geopolitical fascination.
- [The Aesthetics of Intelligence](https://gurubhat.xyz/posts/aesthetics-of-intelligence.html): On knowledge graphs, terminal screenshots, and the market for looking like you are thinking.
- [Formula One Cars for Grocery Runs](https://gurubhat.xyz/posts/formula-one-cars-for-grocery-runs.html): On overbuilt AI workflows, productivity theatre, and why impressive machinery still needs somewhere meaningful to go.
- [smolgate, or How I Learnt to Be Okay With Smaller Context Windows](https://gurubhat.xyz/posts/smolgate.html): On context windows, hoarding, and the fantasy that more memory equals better thought.
- [The Goldilocks Conundrum for AI Enthusiasts](https://gurubhat.xyz/posts/goldilocks-conundrum.html): On model maximalism, capability theatre, and learning when not to call the CEO to decide lunch.
- [Cheap Intelligence Changes Human Psychology More Than Smarter Intelligence](https://gurubhat.xyz/posts/cheap-intelligence.html): On token anxiety, abundant retries, and the weird freedom of not treating every prompt like a prayer.
- [The System That Eats Itself](https://gurubhat.xyz/posts/the-system-that-eats-itself.html): On context drift, compaction, and why the human still has to hold the telos.
- [Tsa](https://gurubhat.xyz/posts/tsa.html): On Tibetan monks, sycophantic AI, and why your LLM is too agreeable to be useful.
- [The Harness Is the Moat](https://gurubhat.xyz/posts/the-harness-is-the-moat.html): On AI, knowledge work, and a Sunday night in Bangalore that got away from me.
- [What We Lost on the Way to Faster](https://gurubhat.xyz/posts/what-we-lost-on-the-way-to-faster.html): On typing, voice input, and the friction that was doing something.
- [Usage Anxiety](https://gurubhat.xyz/posts/usage-anxiety.html): Like range anxiety, but for your thinking.
- [Hello, world](https://gurubhat.xyz/posts/hello-world.html): A short first note on what this place is for, and why a quiet corner of the internet still feels worth making.
